spans.s:
एडु(डू,डो)कः, --कं^1
1 A
building constructed of rubbish,
bones &c., or of hard substances
resembling bones.
--2 A tomb, a wall
round bones.
--3 (With Buddhists)
A sanctuary filled with relics.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20160126. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/215. note: change 'or' to comma for consistency; also equ->equkaH.
